title: 第一卷 第10章 神秘失踪第一卷 第21章 两难抉择
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
过了几日，青云宫内炸开了锅。
值守长老清点在册人员时，长发现常年驻守主峰的长老赵谦，竟不见了踪影。
长老们把全宗上下全搜查了一便，依旧毫无踪迹。
“赵长老怎么突然不见了？”
“昨天傍晚我还在主峰看见他，难不成凭空消失了？”
“会不会是外出游历，未曾报备？”
“可赵长老从没擅自离宗过啊！”
“难道是遭遇秘境高阶妖兽了？”
“亦或是……十年前残留的魔道余孽暗中报复？”
无数猜测传遍宗门，人心惶惶。
几位核心长老齐聚主峰大殿，面色凝重，翻遍了宗门上下，却始终找不到半分线索。
最终只能定论：赵谦长老下山历练，不幸遭遇高阶妖兽袭击，下落不明。
小竹峰上，林枫抬手一挥，一大堆闪着灵气光芒的资源凭空浮现。
正是斩杀赵谦后，从他储物戒中搜刮来的。
中品灵石数千枚、各类疗伤丹药、数套地品功法、防御法器，还有不少珍稀材料。
林枫将功法和防御法器以及一部分疗伤丹都给了柳雨姝。
“这些资源，你拿去用。”林枫淡然吩咐，“好好修炼，争取冲击炼气大圆满。”
柳雨姝看着眼前琳琅满目的宝物，鼻尖微酸，心中一阵温热。
师尊待她真的是倾尽所有、毫无保留。
这世间多少父母都做不到这样。

“叮！检测到宿主杀伐果断、清除隐患，守护弟子道途！”
“触发大爱师尊隐藏奖励！”
“弟子柳雨姝好感度：75！（生死追随）”
“触发28倍暴击返利！”
“奖励：修复灵根天地灵气一缕、高阶疗伤丹【表情】30，随机天阶功法【表情】5，随机天阶防御法器【表情】1！”
清脆的系统提示音在林枫脑海响起，精纯的天地灵力涌入丹田，修复进度直接达到六成！
系统提示音继续响起。
“随即物品抽取中……”
“恭喜宿主获得太阴归一决（天阶）、万灵吞天道（天阶）、空幻无影步（天阶）、镇岳琉璃罩（天阶）、御灵心经（天阶）、九转反灵决（天阶）。”
林枫查看了物品信息，镇岳琉璃罩是一个非常强大的防御法器，可以抵挡一次元婴巅峰修士的全力一击。
太阴归一决这个功法，在夜晚修炼可以吸收太阴精华。
林枫将太阴归一决给了柳雨姝让其修炼。而他自己则又“趁热打铁”，闭关修炼了。
这一练就练了两个月，出来时他已经是筑基八层。
这日，林枫下山喝酒。
清霜剑落至繁华热闹的清溪镇中，此时清溪镇人声鼎沸，很是热闹。
林枫熟门熟路，直奔镇中的临江仙酒楼。
这家百年老点，专供修士与世家之人，店内的饭菜都蕴含这灵力，有各种各样的功效，故而价格也不便宜。
他径直登上二楼雅间，点了一桌珍馐，一壶陈酿灵酒，倚窗独酌。
灵酒入喉，味道清冽醇香，很是舒畅。
就在他举杯之时，楼下突然安静了下来。
content_en:
A few days later, there was an explosion in Qingyun Palace.
When the elder on duty was counting the registered personnel, he discovered that the elder Zhao Qian, who had been stationed at the main peak all year round, was missing.
The elders searched the entire sect, but there was still no trace.
"Why did Elder Zhao suddenly disappear?"
"I saw him on the main peak last night. Could it be that he disappeared out of thin air?"
"Could it be that he went on a trip and didn't report it?"
"But Elder Zhao has never left the clan without permission!"
"Did you encounter a high-level monster in the secret realm?"
"Or...are the remnants of the demonic path from ten years ago secretly seeking revenge?"
Countless speculations spread throughout the sect, and people were panicked.
Several core elders gathered in the main hall of the main peak with solemn expressions. They searched all over the sect but could not find any clues.
In the end, we can only conclude that Elder Zhao Qian went down the mountain to practice, but was unfortunately attacked by a high-level monster and his whereabouts are unknown.
On Xiaozhu Peak, Lin Feng raised his hand and waved, and a large number of resources shining with spiritual energy appeared out of thin air.
It was looted from Zhao Qian's storage ring after killing him.
There are thousands of medium-grade spiritual stones, various healing elixirs, several sets of earth-grade exercises, defensive instruments, and many rare materials.
Lin Feng gave Liu Yushu all the skills and defensive weapons as well as some healing pills.
"Take these resources and use them." Lin Feng said calmly, "Practice well and strive to achieve the Great Perfection of Qi Refining."
Liu Yushu looked at the dazzling array of treasures in front of her, the tip of her nose was slightly sour, and her heart felt warm.
Master treated her with all his heart, without any reservation.
Many parents in this world cannot do this.
"Ding! The host is detected and kills decisively, eliminates hidden dangers, and protects the path of the disciples!"
"Trigger the hidden reward of the Great Love Master!"
"Disciple Liu Yushu's favorability rating: 75! (Follow her through life and death)"
"Trigger 28 times critical hit rebate!"
"Reward: A ray of spiritual energy to repair spiritual roots, high-level healing pills [expression] 30, random heaven-level skills [expression] 5, random heaven-level defensive magic weapon [expression] 1!"
A crisp system prompt sounded in Lin Feng's mind, and the pure spiritual power of heaven and earth poured into his dantian, and the repair progress reached 60%!
The system beep continues to sound.
"The items are being drawn immediately..."
"Congratulations to the host for obtaining the Taiyin Returning One Technique (Heavenly Level), All Souls Devouring Heavenly Dao (Heavenly Level), Konghuan Shadowless Step (Heavenly Level), Zhenyue Glass Cover (Heavenly Level), Soul-Restraining Heart Sutra (Heavenly Level), and Nine Revolutions Reversal of Spirits (Heavenly Level)."
Lin Feng checked the item information and found that the Zhenyue Glazed Cover was a very powerful defensive weapon that could withstand a full blow from a peak Nascent Soul cultivator.
Taiyin Guiyijue is a technique that can be practiced at night to absorb the essence of Taiyin.
Lin Feng gave Liu Yushu Taiyin Guiyijue to practice. And he himself "strike while the iron is hot" and went into seclusion to practice.
This training lasted two months, and when he came out, he was already at the eighth level of foundation building.
On this day, Lin Feng went down the mountain to drink.
The Qingshuang Sword fell into the bustling Qingxi Town. At this time, Qingxi Town was full of people and very lively.
Lin Feng was familiar with the roads and went straight to Linjiangxian Restaurant in the town.
This century-old restaurant is dedicated to monks and people from aristocratic families. The food in the store contains this spiritual power and has various effects, so the prices are not cheap.
He went straight to the private room on the second floor, ordered a table of delicacies, a pot of aged wine, and drank alone by the window.
The spirit wine enters the throat, the taste is refreshing and mellow, and it is very comfortable.
Just as he was toasting, the downstairs suddenly became quiet.
